about: Checks that fail today because of known WEMU bugs. run.py reports them as 'known' instead of failing the run; any other failure is a regression. When a bug is fixed its probes pass, run.py reports them as 'fixed', and the entry must be removed. 'order_dependent' entries pass when their scene runs alone, so passing is not reported as fixed. refs point to docs/quality/regressions.md.

guest_readback.reason: GX2CopySurface reads back on the CPU before the frame is rendered, so the RPX reads zeros

forward_lit/texture_mip_level3.reason: mip levels above 0 are never uploaded

loops/loop_escape.reason: stale shader reused at a recycled guest address
